title: Resting EEG
description: Resting-state EEG recorded with a 128-channel EGI system from participants who also underwent structural MRI. The dataset was first reported in a study of whole-brain electrophysiological functional connectivity dynamics in resting-state EEG. Data were preprocessed with band-pass and notch filtering, artifact and bad-channel handling, average re-referencing, and downsampling to 250 Hz.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a 128-channel Amps 300 amplifier (Electrical Geodesics Inc.) at 1000 Hz during rest. Structural MRI was acquired on a GE MR750 scanner using the BRAVO sequence (FOV 240 mm, 180 axial slices per slab). Preprocessing in EEGLAB included a 0.5-100 Hz band-pass filter, a 58-62 Hz notch filter, removal of noisy channels and artifacts, interpolation of bad channels, average re-referencing, and downsampling to 250 Hz.
